messages:
alex: Observed recurring Xid/ECC spikes on rack-16 GPUs over the last ~36h — 8 distinct cards showing progressive ECC drift. Creating thread for RCA and quarantine plan. Please add any findings/resources.

infra-bot: :warning: gpu-health alert — rack-16 anomaly detected. Avg ECC error rate increased 8x vs baseline. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/devices/rack-16/health

maya: Quick triage summary: failures start around 1978590000. Pattern includes small thermal excursions followed by step increases in ECC counts. Serial clustering: S/Ns in range 3L1000–3L1A7F (vendor lot Q3B-ink). Thermal soak on two suspect cards yesterday reproduced ECC growth after repeated cycles.

sam: Noted host-side power events concurrent with some spikes — host logs show PSU_BROWNOUTs and a couple of unexpected power caps. Leaving note: could be VRM/PSU coupling rather than pure silicon defect.

jordan: Runtime traces show increased long-sequence workloads during the window; continuous high utilization + eviction churn likely increased die temps and KV cache pressure. That can exacerbate marginal silicon behaviors.

maya: Small data excerpt from the monitoring export (CSV-ish):
```
metric,timestamp,ecc_delta,host
ECC_DELTA,2026-03-14T02:00Z,0.2,rack-16-node05
ECC_DELTA,2026-03-14T05:30Z,5.8,rack-16-node05
ECC_DELTA,2026-03-14T06:10Z,12.1,rack-16-node12
```
Cross-checked other racks — no similar pattern. Also checked firmware: all affected cards on driver version 525.89 (same as baseline).

leah: Procurement note: those serial ranges shipped in Dec 2025 from vendor "AlphaFab" (lot Q3B-ink). Vendor acknowledged a minor reflow profile variance in that lot during internal QA but claimed within tolerance. I'm opening a QA request and asking for their lot test logs.

alex: Proposed immediate actions:
1) Quarantine the S/N range and mark nodes for drain (ETA: start draining in 1h).
2) Run controlled thermal-cycling on 4 additional suspect cards (maya).
3) Open vendor RMA for confirmed failed cards after bench repro (leah).
4) Deep-dive host PSU/VRM logs for correlated events (sam).
5) Short-term routing: move latency-sensitive inference off rack-16 to dedicated pool / rack-9 (jordan).

maya: I've kicked off drains on node05, node12, node18. Drains are progressing; one job failed to checkpoint and SRE is handling restart. Starting bench thermal cycles on two spare cards now.

sam: Found a PSU event that correlates: host rack-16-node12 logged "PSU_BROWNOUT" at 1978639000, right before the first ECC spike we saw on node12. Investigating PSU telemetry retention.

jordan: Implemented temporary routing override for production inference: added policy to route model-serving traffic away from rack-16 to dedicated inference pool until we have final confirmation. Also enabled extra monitoring on fallback pool.

alex: Timeline: thermal-cycle bench results expected within 24h; vendor QA reply expected within 48h; RMAs to start once we have bench repro + confirmed S/N list. I'll own coordination with procurement and vendor. :thumbsup:

maya: Quick bench update: thermal-cycling reproduced ECC growth after ~10 cycles on 2 benched cards from the suspect lot. Saved waveform and BIST logs under /shared/triage/rack16/1978642000. Will attach full export when tests complete.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-72 assigned to eng-infra.

leah: Starting RMA paperwork — will need the final failed S/N list and test artifacts. Please drop when ready.

alex: Thanks all. We'll sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to review bench artifacts and vendor reply. If anything changes before then, post here.
